body.statement: Using the Rademacher predictable-variation handle, establish under each of \(\mathbb H_n^{\mathrm{same}}\) and \(\mathbb H_n^{\mathrm{ind}}\) that \(Q_n/\sigma_n^2\xrightarrow{p}1\) with prior probability \(1-o(1)\), and construct deterministic diagonal schedule arrays in \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{dense}}\) whose one-realization laws have total-variation distance tending to zero while their scaled variances remain separated. Deduce that there exist \(\varepsilon,\delta>0\) such that every measurable \(\widehat S_n(\mathcal O_n)\) satisfies \[\liminf_{n\to\infty}\sup_{Y\in\mathcal C_{\mathrm{dense}}}\Pr_Y\left(\left|\frac{\widehat S_n}{\sigma_n^2}-1\right|>\varepsilon\right)\ge\delta.\]
body.justification: This is the genuine open content needed to turn observation equivalence into a uniform all-statistic impossibility theorem on the same CLT class used for inference.
body.gap: HarshawMiddletonSavje2026 replaces unavailable exact variance by optimized conservative bounds, but does not give this random-partition observation-channel lower bound; Chao1997 does not verify predictable variation for the two-stage grouped statistic.
body.consumer: A positive resolution tells analysts why no one-realization correction can uniformly remove dense CR2 conservativeness without structural restrictions, repeated regrouping, or variance bounds.
